articles.title: Melioidosis, a Deadly Soil Infection That Mimics TB, Is Going Undetected Across India
articles.excerpt: A 15-centre Lancet study found the infection in 8.9% of high-risk hospital patients, and one in five died. The disease is not notifiable in India, labs routinely misidentify the bacterium, and standard TB treatment does not work against it.
articles.image_caption: Colonies of Burkholderia pseudomallei, the soil bacterium that causes melioidosis, growing on Ashdown agar. The infection mimics tuberculosis and is going undetected across India.

sources.label: US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

articles.nri_angle: Diaspora families with diabetic parents in coastal and monsoon-soaked parts of India are the group most likely to meet this infection, and most likely to lose weeks to a wrong TB diagnosis first.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

items.note: The strongest risk factor; poor blood-sugar control sharply raises the risk of severe disease

Sickle cell disease or a weakened immune system

articles.title: NHS Clears Five AI Tools to Help Spot Prostate Cancer on MRI Scans
articles.excerpt: NICE has recommended five AI programs for NHS use over a two-year evidence-gathering period. They highlight possible cancer on prostate MRI scans for radiologists — who still review every scan — but NICE says proof of accuracy in routine practice is still limited.
articles.nri_angle: The NHS rollout is relevant to the large Indian-origin community in the UK, heavily represented among both NHS clinicians and patients, as AI-assisted prostate MRI reporting begins in English trusts.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India to Count Unpaid Work, Gig Workers in Jobs Survey Overhaul
articles.excerpt: The PLFS redesign from January 2027 adds a dedicated sample for digital platform workers and first-time questions on unpaid household and care work, and will change how India's employment numbers read.
articles.nri_angle: The PLFS overhaul changes how India's jobs data will read from 2027, giving diaspora readers a truer picture of gig work and women's unpaid labour behind the headline unemployment rate.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Mann Says Delhi Airport Hold-Up Was Revenge, Links Customs Chief to CEC
articles.excerpt: Speaking in the Punjab Assembly, Bhagwant Mann alleged he was made to sit for two hours at Delhi airport and fined Rs 50,000 because the Delhi Customs chief is Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar's brother — a claim the BJP counters by saying he was caught with undeclared luxury goods.
articles.nri_angle: The row matters to Punjabi diaspora readers following Punjab politics: a sitting chief minister has publicly accused central institutions of using an airport customs check as political revenge.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: All 14 Indians Aboard Yacht Off Yemen Reported Safe Around Hodeidah
articles.excerpt: India's embassy in Yemen said Friday all 14 nationals are safe near Hodeidah, a day after the Houthis claimed Saudi forces targeted their boat near the Bab el-Mandeb.
articles.image_caption: A large vessel sails on calm seas in a file image of maritime traffic. All 14 Indian nationals aboard a yacht involved in an incident off Yemen were reported safe around Hodeidah on Friday.
articles.nri_angle: The confirmed safety of 14 Indian seafarers near Hodeidah brings relief to families, in a week when an Indian was killed in the Dammam airport attack.

articles.title: Magnitude 7.0 Earthquake in Tibet Kills 16, Injures 65 as Rescue Expands
articles.excerpt: The late-night quake in Baqen County collapsed at least 339 homes and displaced more than 12,000 people, with rescuers working at extreme altitude in subfreezing conditions.
articles.nri_angle: Tremor risk on the Tibetan Plateau is followed closely in Himalayan-border communities in India and Nepal with family ties across the region.

articles.title: Petraeus Urges India to Build Rapid New Warfare Concept for Two-Front Threat
articles.excerpt: The former CIA director told the NDTV World Summit that India must tailor modern, AI-enabled warfare concepts to its own theatres, with China and Pakistan as the central challenge.
articles.nri_angle: Defence doctrine debates in New Delhi shape the security environment diaspora families follow closely on India-China and India-Pakistan tensions.

articles.title: Face-Offs With China Happened in Arunachal in Past Few Days and Continue, ITBP Chief Says
articles.excerpt: Director General Shatrujeet Singh Kapoor's confirmation — the first since July — points to fresh friction around Taksing, as the force raises drone platoons and a Galwan-style Strike course.
articles.nri_angle: A verified status report on the India-China border for diaspora readers: fresh face-offs confirmed in Arunachal's Taksing sector, a corps-commander channel already used once, and a political fight in Delhi over what it means.
